title: Identification and validation of key complement system-related genes for recurrent spontaneous abortion via WGCNA and machine learning.
authors: Chen, Lin; Shao, Yu; Pan, Xianshun; Lai, Ting
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过WGCNA和机器学习识别复发性流产相关补体基因，虽构建了转录因子-基因网络，但核心是疾病生物标志物筛选，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Recurrent spontaneous abortion (RSA) is a major reproductive challenge with multifaceted causes, including genetic and immunological influences. Complement system-related genes (CRGs) have been implicated in RSA pathogenesis, yet their exact roles remain unclear. This study aims to identify related biomarkers for RSA and investigate the underlying mechanisms. Datasets GSE65099 and GSE26787 were obtained from the GEO database. The GSE65099 dataset was used to identify differentially expressed genes (DEGs), which were intersected with key module genes identified from WGCNA to obtain DE-CRGs related to RSA. Then, key CRGs were screened by combined PPI networks, machine learning, and external validation. A nomogram model was developed for the diagnosis of RSA with key CRG expression levels, followed by validation via ROC curve analysis. Transcription factor-key gene and chemical-gene networks were constructed to reveal the potential mechanisms of key CRGs. Totally, 363 DE-CRGs were selected, and GRAP2 and TREM2 were identified as key genes for RSA, which were both upregulated in RSA samples. The two genes showed excellent diagnostic performance in both the training and validation cohorts. GSEA revealed that GRAP2 and TREM2 were involved in immune-related pathways. Immune infiltration analysis showed that GRAP2 and TREM2 had a negative correlation with effector memory CD4 T cells. Drug prediction identified that the two genes had 3 common interacting chemicals, including bisphenol A, tetrachlorodibenzodioxin, and air pollutants. In conclusion, this study identified GRAP2 and TREM2 as key genes for RSA and provided insights into the immune mechanisms underlying the condition. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: The online version contains supplementary material available at 10.1007/s10616-026-00901-3.
abstract_zh: 复发性自然流产（RSA）是一个具有多因素病因的重大生殖挑战，包括遗传和免疫学影响。补体系统相关基因（CRGs）已被认为与RSA发病机制有关，但其确切作用仍不清楚。本研究旨在识别RSA的相关生物标志物并探讨其潜在机制。从GEO数据库获取了GSE65099和GSE26787数据集。使用GSE65099数据集识别差异表达基因（DEGs），并将其与WGCNA鉴定的关键模块基因相交集，以获得与RSA相关的DE-CRGs。随后，通过结合PPI网络、机器学习和外部验证筛选关键CRGs。基于关键CRG表达水平构建了用于RSA诊断的列线图模型，并通过ROC曲线分析进行验证。构建了转录因子-关键基因和化学物质-基因网络，以揭示关键CRGs的潜在机制。共筛选出363个DE-CRGs，其中GRAP2和TREM2被确定为RSA的关键基因，两者在RSA样本中均上调。这两个基因在训练队列和验证队列中均表现出优异的诊断性能。GSEA显示GRAP2和TREM2参与免疫相关通路。免疫浸润分析表明，GRAP2和TREM2与效应记忆CD4 T细胞呈负相关。药物预测识别出这两个基因有3种共同的相互作用化学物质，包括双酚A、四氯二苯并二噁英和空气污染物。总之，本研究将GRAP2和TREM2确定为RSA的关键基因，并为该病症的免疫机制提供了见解。补充信息：在线版本包含补充材料，可在10.1007/s10616-026-00901-3获取。
